inputBoundaryInventory.summary: coderedcms is a Django/Wagtail web CMS, so the untrusted-input boundaries are: (1) the URL path variable of the protected-media route - the (?P<path>.*) group injects the whole request path below /protected/ into serve_protected_file(request, path) which joins it onto PROTECTED_MEDIA_ROOT and opens it; (2) request.GET/POST/FILES/META reads across views.py, page_models.py, wagtail_flexible_forms and wagtail_hooks (search/filter/pagination params, event ical POST params, form POST/FILES, HTTP_REFERER); (3) multipart upload file names - file.name / val.name / value.name attribute reads that flow into str(Path(directory) / name) destination construction; (4) uploaded file content reads (file.chunks(), val.chunks(), form.cleaned_data['file'].read()); (5) the DB-submission boundary - json.loads of stored form_data / thumbnails_by_path / subscriber_json_data whose values were user-supplied at submission time and are re-used as file paths (get_thumbnail_path, delete_file, delete_files); (6) the session store (request.session / self.request.session reads and the session_key directory component - server-generated random value, not automatically attacker-controlled); (7) the CLI (sys.argv and the argparse options dict of coderedcms/bin/coderedcms.py, operator trust level); (8) cr_settings configuration subscripts (deployment-level constants). The sink side funnels through builtin open() (one site - the protected-media view), the Django FileSystemStorage API (storage.open/path/get_available_name/delete/listdir/url + the FileSystemStorage constructor), pathlib Path()/mkdir/rmdir/with_suffix/attribute propagation, PIL Image.open/thumbnail.save, file-handle write, and the os.path join/check/resolve propagation pipeline.

guardsAndEvidence.guard: protected-media route: NO traversal containment (guard absence, CWE-022 primary evidence)
guardsAndEvidence.evidence: coderedcms/views.py:110-:123 - fullpath = os.path.join(cr_settings['PROTECTED_MEDIA_ROOT'], path) at :114 followed directly by os.path.isfile at :115 and open(fullpath, 'rb') at :117. No base-directory containment check, no '..' rejection, no basename extraction, no normpath/realpath comparison, no safe_join. os.path.join semantics let a leading-'..' or absolute path component escape PROTECTED_MEDIA_ROOT. The only gate is @login_required (:109) - an authentication boundary that limits WHO can request, not WHAT path is opened. TOCTOU note: the isfile check at :115 and the open at :117 are separate syscalls.

coderedcms/forms.py:60-:74 SecureFileField.validate -> _check_whitelist/_check_blacklist use os.path.splitext(value.name)[1].lower() against cr_settings['PROTECTED_MEDIA_UPLOAD_WHITELIST'] / BLACKLIST (blacklist default: .sh .exe .bat .ps1 .app .jar .py .php .pl .rb, settings.py:14). Extension-only validation: it constrains the suffix, not path separators or absolute names in value.name.

guardsAndEvidence.guard: pathlib division destination construction (semantics, not a guard)
guardsAndEvidence.evidence: coderedcms/models/page_models.py:1211 and wff models.py:244 - str(Path(directory) / val.name): pathlib semantics replace `directory` entirely when val.name is absolute (e.g. 'C:\x' on Windows or '/x' on POSIX); when relative, subdirectory traversal via '..' segments survives. The directory component is the server-generated session_key. storage.get_available_name (page:1210, wff:243) only deduplicates names (appends suffixes); any sanitization it applies is Django-internal and external to this database.

guardsAndEvidence.guard: external-library boundaries (cannot be verified from this DB)
guardsAndEvidence.evidence: The MultiPartParser-side handling of client filenames, FileSystemStorage.path()/open()/delete() containment (Django implements path() resolution and raises on paths escaping the storage root), wagtail page-URL routing, and wagtailimportexport are all outside the coderedcms repo and thus outside the CodeQL database; their behavior is recorded as an evidence gap rather than assumed either way.

coderedcms/views.py:109 @login_required on serve_protected_file and :229 @login_required on import_pages_from_csv_file; wagtail_flexible_forms/wagtail_hooks.py admin views run under wagtail admin permissions. These limit the attacker population (authenticated users / staff) but do not sanitize the path or filename values - Django auth middleware is contextual, not sanitization (django.md section 8).
